jobs_results.title: Backend-Entwickler/In, Informatiker/In
jobs_results.description: Git, Backend, Objektorientierte Programmierung, Versicherungssoftware, IT, Informatik, Softwareentwicklung, Hardware, Datenbanken, Java We have something that will help you own: your next job! intersoft is an IT company specializing in insurance software and a wholly owned subsidiary of WWK Lebensversicherung a.G. We develop software solutions exclusively for WWK. The maintenance, modernization and expansion of our portfolio management system lifestream, which was developed especially for WWK, is our main responsibility. We are constantly on the lookout for innovative minds with ingenuity, acumen and ideas - not only to develop new IT solutions, but also to achieve common goals. In short: we're looking for you! Senior Backend Developer (m/f/d) What you bring to the table: You have sound know-how in the field of object-oriented software development with Java and have experience in the support and further development of a grown system You have conceptual design skills and are adept at... identifying, analyzing and documenting requirements - you are happy to take on testing independently after implementation You analyze the causes of problems both independently and as part of a team and enjoy cracking complex problems, researching errors and debugging You communicate complex technical content to your customers in a target group-oriented and understandable way and have a high technical and equally high professional affinity You combine your analytical, systematic and conceptual way of thinking with a high level of quality awareness and a strong focus on results You have a good sense for potential challenges, act preventively and share them with your team and stakeholders You find pragmatic and practicable solutions, are assertive and able to reach consensus You have already found your balance between focused work and team play - you enrich your team with your openness, motivation and proactivity You have trained as an IT specialist, have a degree in computer science or a comparable qualification - professional experience in insurance or finance is an advantage What you can expect at intersoft: You enjoy taking on technical challenges and always think outside the box. The fact that your implementations always combine the tried and tested with necessary innovations spurs you on to find the best possible and feasible solutions. You are passionate about sharing these results with your team and taking your product to the next level together - and you mainly do this remotely. We support you in growing in your role, bringing in your new ideas and putting them into practice - we offer you the appropriate playing field. This is what there is to do: Together with your team, you will develop software in the Provision subsystem as part of the functional expansion of WWK's core system You always keep an eye on the further development of the technical mapping of processes You have a desire to delve deeply into complex technical processes to ensure secure and valuable software in the long term Your tasks include driving forward the modernization and improvement of the maintainability of the code base through targeted refactorings - for this you develop business cases and are in close contact with the product owner You are jointly responsible for the technical requirements gathering - the evaluation, analysis and resolution of error tickets are part of your daily work, in close cooperation with your colleagues You are responsible for the quality assurance of your work and the creation of necessary technical documentation - you create automated tests, execute queries in the database and push your code changes to Git Your work does not end at the edge of your plate - in order to maintain your product, but at the same time develop it further, you work as deeply as possible into the existing system and thus build up the necessary specialist knowledge With your drive and experience, you help your team to achieve their goals and set new impulses - so you continuously increase your performance A proactive and solution-oriented way of communicating with colleagues at intersoft and WWK is part of it Convinced? Then apply for a job with us! Not convinced yet? Here are a few things that set us apart from the rest: Maximum flexibility and adaptability for employee satisfaction Symbolically open doors, flat hierarchies, family atmosphere Real teams that exchange information on a planned and spontaneous basis every day Central location and ideal transport connections Modern hardware and software equipment - whether in the office or at home Extras such as the Germany ticket, company sports, company social benefits, individual training programs Reliable job with prospects Free ice cream in the office, drinks, fruit and many other great employee benefits Good work-life balance and a pleasant working atmosphere Mobile first - as much mobile working as you want There we go, now! Sounds good? Then we should get to know each other. Please send us your application documents with your salary expectations and earliest possible starting date via our application form at ****** Your contact person in the HR Unit is Miriam. intersoft AG, Frankenstraße 18 a, 20097 Hamburg, www.intersoft.de You can find more information about the WWK Group at www.wwk.de * If you apply to us by e-mail, please note the following information: Sending by e-mail to our address ****** is usually unencrypted. This means that unauthorized access to your data cannot be ruled out. For security reasons, we recommend that you only send e-mails in encrypted form. Please do not send us any sensitive data by unencrypted e-mail. You can find our public PGP key for sending an encrypted email on our website at https://www.intersoft.de/assets/pgp_jobs.asc.txt. The fingerprint for this is: 345D F208 C278 94AF C05C 64A6 20AB 5058 0BF3 3FB5. Alternatively, you can send us your application by post. If you contact us by unencrypted e-mail, this is expressly on a voluntary basis and with your consent, Art. 6 para. 1 a GDPR. In this case, we also assume your consent to contact you via the communication channel you have chosen (unencrypted email) in order to respond to your request. If you do not wish us to do this, please let us know. You can of course withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end
jobs_results.description:
¡Ampliamos equipo!🚀

Madrija es una empresa tecnológica con sede en Toledo y oficinas en Ciudad Real, Talavera, Sevilla y Barcelona.

Actualmente estamos 🕵️♂️ incorporar desarrolladores back para uno de nuestros clientes de la Administración pública.

Trabajarás con el siguiente marco tecnológico:

Tecnologías como Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Angular, Kubernetes, Docker, Kibana y Elasticsearch entre otros.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

El desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y la evolución de los sistemas actuales, que contemplan:
• Arquitecturas orientadas a servicios y microservicios.
• Aplicación multientidad
• Desarrollo de APIs REST.
• Capa servidor principalmente en Java y Spring Framework.
• Integración de logs, saml...

Todos los equipos de trabajo se mueven bajo metodologías de desarrollo ágiles, tomándose de referencia la metodología SCRUM.

¿Qué necesitamos que tengas?
• Ingeniería informática o similares
• Experiencia de, al menos, 4-5 años como desarrollador.
•... Sería un plus que tuvieses experiencia en proyectos de Administración pública

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido y plan de carrera
• Salario fijo + variable
• Seguro médico
• Horario flexible. Viernes de todo el año y verano, jornada intensiva de mañana.
• Teletrabajo
• No trabajar en tu cumpleaños y recibir un cheque regalo
• Formación técnica y en idiomas
• Jornadas de team building y actividades corporativas

Y si algo de lo que lees aquí te resulta atractivo... no lo dudes, escríbenos a empleo@madrija.com para que te contemos más.

¡Te esperamos! #equipomadrija

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer - PHP (m/f)
jobs_results.description:
Akens \ Nordburg is looking for a Senior Backend Developer (m/f) to enlarge the IT development team based in Madrid of a leading German company within the furniture retail sector. Our client has seen in the past years a substantial shift towards e-commerce, making it a core component of the company business strategy.

The company is currently focused on an omnichannel approach, seamlessly integrating the physical and digital channels to offer customers a unified shopping experience.

Your responsibilities:
• As a backend developer in our cross-functional agile team, you will be responsible for the further development of our online shop and omni-channel-services based on Spryker.
• You will be evolving its integration into the Company system landscape.
• You will work closely with our product developers and contribute to the requirements analysis, conception and architecture of existing and new products.
• As part of the team, you continuously update and improve our quality... standards.
• You shape and enrich our CI/CD pipeline, including monitoring and test automation.
• You work pragmatically and can also implement smaller requirements yourself.

Requirements:
• You are an experienced backend developer with a passion for complex systems.
• You have very good skills in web technologies based on PHP (Symfony), RESTful Web Services and in Relational Databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and GIT.
• You have experience with JSON, Redis, RabitMQ, CI/CD and Cashing.
• Ideally you have experience in Monitoring & Observability Tools (e. g. NewRelic, Zabbix, Instana, Grafana).
• You are characterized by a commitment to continuous development.
• You are interested in new technologies.
• You are enthusiastic about innovations.

Our promise:

Become part of one of the most successful furniture companies in Germany. As a solid family business, the company stands for the highest degree of fairness in our dealings with one another and place great value on flat corporate hierarchies with the best opportunities for advancement.

You can expect a crisis-proof position with a varied range of tasks and an attractive, performance-based salary model with a pleasant working environment

Compañía 📈

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer (Hybrid, Madrid based candidates ONLY)
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Backend Engineer to join the team.

Remote candidates must be living (or willing to live) in: Spain.

Job description

As a Backend Engineer, you will work together with our development team, product managers, and designers. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to build, to collaborate and to create value and direct impact to our users. We love to find team members that challenge and question the features they are working on.

Our Frontend is built with ReactJS. We use Figma to build our proprietary Design System and UI Kit. Our Backend runs on NodeJS and our platform on Google Cloud, it keeps us moving fast and scale up, but with strong resiliency.

What will you do?
• Work with an experienced development team and product managers to ideate, brainstorm and build impressive financial features... Code hard, think hard.
• Design, develop and maintain our APIs and web applications for maximum robustness, scalability and security.
• Test all new features and enhancements to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. This includes mastering troubleshooting, debugging and upgrades. We also need you to document your code to make sure the team is fully aligned.
• Help us protect our users' data, confidentiality and integrity by creating security and data protection settings.
• Help build CI/CD, monitoring and testing practices together with the rest of the team.
• Work in a comfortable and rewarding environment, making sure that this company's culture and mission is safeguarded and spread.
• Be ready to develop skills and learn from other areas they might have expertise on.

What are we looking for?
• 4+ years of experience as a Backend or FullStack engineer using Javascript/Typescript
• Experience scaling distributed systems with large data volumes
• Strong knowledge of software architecture design patterns and coding best practices.
• You like taking responsibility, ownership and creating impact. We need builders and problem solvers who feel proud and liable for our success. Advocate a quality culture across the whole organization.
• You are comfortable with testing environments and make sure every detail is brushed before going to production. You are passionate about high quality.
• You are highly organized and can adjust priorities, having great attention to detail. You understanding the difference between perfect and a good-enough result
• Team player: "We" is always before "I". We need versatility, humility, and team members that enjoy working and learning from each other.
• You are ambitious: curious to learn about new tools and getting to the bottom of each problem
• Background studies related to Computer Science

jobs_results.title: Python Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Title: Python Backend Software Engineer

Type: Permanent contract

Location: Valencia

About Us

At Visium, we enable enterprise executives in defining their AI & Data strategy, execute large scale transformations and implement AI across operations, ensuring their organization becomes future-proof.

With expertise in strategy, architecture, cloud engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence and machine learning, we empower our clients to unleash and scale the power of their data.

We're on a mission to pioneer a bright future and build future-proof and ethical organizations . Join the curious, the ambitious, the doers, the good-hearted, the ones who build a world we're all in awe of - our Visumees.

Ready to become one?

Role

As an experienced Backend Software Engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live and maintaining the platform we deliver. You will leverage your backend programming skills to build real-life micro-services that serve the... Visium AI systems in close collaboration with other software and ML engineers. You are passionate about understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. Finally, you are meticulously organized and prepared to work in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment.

As a Backend Software Engineer, you will in responsible for:
• Develop and maintain cloud-native applications using containerization, Azure and Kubernetes
• Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code using Python
• Implement unit tests to ensure high-quality software
• Design, document and implement REST APIs with FastAPI
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, utilizing Neo4j, MongoDB, and Redis for data storage and management
• Implement REST APIs for seamless integration with the frontend
• Manage CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment of software
• Utilize GitOps and a DevOps mindset to ensure efficient and effective software development and deployment

Requirements

We are looking for
• 3+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer or Software Developer or in a relevant role
• Proficiency in Python and unit testing
• Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes
• Strong understanding of Neo4j, MongoDB, and Redis
• Experience with Docker, ArgoCD, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps
• Experience with fundamental front-end languages (HTML, CSS and JavaScript)
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Understanding of the management of the development of a product (agile, scrum)
• Understanding of Unix/Linux operating systems
• Hands-on in object-oriented programming, large-scale software architecture, and networking
• Understanding of secure backend/frontend communication

Previous experience in consulting role(s) is a plus

Benefits

What we offer
• A competitive compensation package
• A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
• A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
• A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
• A position that enables you to have an impact on 1'000s of people, and the whole company's growth
• An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions

¡Hola! Somos CAPGEMINI, una compañía TOP EMPLOYER con 360.000 PERSONAS en todo el mundo unidas por una misma pasión: liderar la evolución hacia un futuro sostenible e inclusivo a través de la TECNOLOGÍA. No importa dónde estemos, podemos estar en casa, en la oficina, a mil quilómetros de distancia unxs de otrxs, pero somos conscientes de que NUESTRO TRABAJO CUENTA.No importa en qué momento vital estemos, somos DIVERSOS en edad, género, ascendencia, familia… ¡nos hemos certificado en Diversidad y como empresa ÉTICA más de 10 años seguidos!

Estamos desarrollando un proyecto desafiante y para esta oportunidad, en nuestra área Cloud&Custom Applications (CCA) buscamos un/a Backend Developer con 5 años de experiencia con Java + SpringBoot + Cloud.

Para el desarrollo de este proyecto es imprescindible contar con conocimientos en:

Java (últimas versiones)

Springboot

Swagger

Cloud AWS (deseable)

Mockito

Unit Testing

Jenkins

Contexto Agile

Maven

Valoramos la responsabilidad, el... compromiso y el trabajo en equipo.

En Capgemini contamos con una amplísima oferta formativa, presencial, online de Certificaciones, etc. Aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos valorados ¡nos encantará conocerte!

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades hace que tengamos un Plan de Igualdad y un Código Ético que garantizan el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección dentro de un entorno libre de discriminación por cuestión de etnia, nacionalidad, origen social, edad, orientación sexual, expresión de género, religión o cualquier otra circunstancia personal, física o social.

La colaboración es clave en el desarrollo de nuevas ideas, de nuevas soluciones, del crecimiento profesional y personal y por eso para nosotrxs es vital el equipo y el buen clima. Trabajamos y potenciamos nuestras COMUNIDADES dentro de la compañía.

Tenemos un CATALOGO DE MEDIDAS de desarrollo y conciliación muy completo (ayudas familiares, seguros y tickets, días festivos adicionales de tiempo para ti y lxs tuyxs, etc…) ¿Nos vemos y te lo contamos?

Hoy has conocido algo más sobre nosotrxs y nuestro proyecto en crecimiento. Mañana saldrán otros proyectos porque así trabajamos, generando soluciones a medida que se nos necesita ¿Te unes al equipo hoy

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam—and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

Over the past two years, our team has fuelled exponential growth, securing $50 million in investments and propelling us into hyper-growth mode. We’re on track to become a unicorn start-up by 2025, backed by global funds like General Catalyst (known for supporting Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe). Finom has expanded its reach across 10+ EU countries, with a strong presence in key markets like Germany and France.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience—we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation... and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We are seeking a Senior backend engineer to improve, maintain, and develop the best security practices for the world's most innovative product. If you're ready to take on the challenge of working with the best product and technology stack in the world, read on.

What You Will Be Doing
• Develop new and maintain existing microservices.
• Architecting, developing, and maintaining high-quality financial services for small and medium-sized businesses in European countries using the C# programming language and .NET Core platform.
• Managing the technical development team, including task allocation, code quality control, and ensuring timely delivery; code review;
• Making strategic technical decisions, considering product requirements and business goals, as well as optimizing system performance and scalability.

Our technology stack: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

Who You Are
• Knowledge of the principles and practical experience in the application of OOP, SOLID, microservice architecture;
• Excellent knowledge of .NET(.Net Core), C#;
• At least 5 years experience as a backend developer
• Knowledge of English for fluent reading of technical documentation;
• Desirable: Ability to write tests.

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us, working from our elegant offices in Paphos (Cyprus) and Amsterdam (the Netherlands), with upcoming hubs in Poland and Spain. Enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working in a remote/hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Next Steps

Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within the next few days.

Standard interview process:
• Application Review - 3 - 5 days
• Recruiter Interview - 30 min -45 min
• Hiring Manager Interview - 45 min - 1 hour
• Test Task - up to 1 hour
• Final Interview - 45 min - 1 hour
• Offer

Please note the order and duration of each step can vary depending on the type of position and seniority level.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics
